text: The Righteous Will Be Remembered Foreverא AlephPraise Yah!How blessed is the man who fears Yahweh,ב BethWho greatly delights in His commandments.
ג GimelHis seed will be mighty on earth;ד DalethThe generation of the upright will be blessed.
ה HeWealth and riches are in his house,ו VavAnd his righteousness stands forever.
ז ZayinLight arises in the darkness for the upright;ח HethHe is gracious and compassionate and righteous.
ט TethIt is well with the man who is gracious and lends;י YodhWho sustains his works with justice.
כ KaphFor he will never be shaken;ל LamedhThe righteous will be remembered forever.
מ MemHe will not fear an evil report;נ NunHis heart is set, trusting in Yahweh.
ס SamekhHis heart is upheld, he will not fear,ע AyinUntil he looks in triumph on his adversaries.
פ PeHe has given freely to the needy,צ TsadheHis righteousness stands forever;ק QophHis horn will be raised in glory.
ר ReshThe wicked will see it and be vexed,שׁ ShinHe will gnash his teeth and melt away;ת TavThe desire of the wicked will perish.
